products.name: MEMENTO
products.description:
MEMENTO
It started with a silly question: why does my phone need 5 apps? One for photos, one for music, one for PDFs, one for QR codes, one for notes. So I said: let's put them all in one, and make it work without internet.
What's inside:
- A photo and video gallery with albums and favorites
- 10 offline tools (Image to PDF, PDF Merger, compressor, QR, and more)
- A music player that keeps playing in the background
- A drawing corner
- An encrypted private space
- 3 languages: Arabic (full RTL), English, French
And the intro screen has a tidy stack of pills. Touch one by mistake and everything
